About

Data science that ships, not just notebooks

Data Scientist with 5+ years across machine learning, generative AI and cloud engineering. I work on AWS — SageMaker, Bedrock and EC2 — building models, RAG applications and the pipelines that keep them running in production.

My recent work includes a live Mobile Money fraud detection API modelled on PaySim synthetic mobile-money data, aimed at MTN MoMo / Orange Money–style transactions: a RandomForest model scoring Precision 0.85 and ROC-AUC 0.965 on that PaySim evaluation, deployed with FastAPI and Docker, with CI/CD and MLOps practices around it.

Alongside data science, I bring 4+ years of DevOps — Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD — and I am cofounder & technical lead at SIDEKOM, a communications and marketing agency where I build client websites and automation.

    ● Live in production

    Mobile Money Fraud Detection API

    Detects fraudulent Mobile Money transactions (MTN MoMo / Orange Money patterns) from transaction features. Trained on the first 100,000 PaySim rows — only 116 were fraud (0.116%) — so the model was built for extreme class imbalance, then served as a real API anyone can call.

    Blog ↔ LinkedIn: a mix, not a copy

    LinkedIn gets the short version — one post a day, 150–250 words, one image, a question at the end.

    The blog gets the long version of the same topic — headings, code, screenshots and links — so it stays findable on Google long after the LinkedIn post fades. Each links to the other.

    What this site collects

    This is a static portfolio site. It has no account sign-up, no comment system and no contact form that stores your data. If you email me or message me on LinkedIn, I receive the details you choose to send, and I use them only to reply.

    Cookies & advertising

    This site does not currently run advertising. If Google AdSense is added in future, Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising in your Google Ads Settings, and you can block or clear cookies in your browser at any time.

    External links

    Links on this site go to LinkedIn, GitHub, SIDEKOM and the live project API. Those sites have their own privacy policies, which I do not control.
